policies.topic: Standard Shipping Delivery Time
policies.content: Standard domestic shipping takes 3-5 business days within the continental United States.

policies.topic: Free Shipping Minimum Threshold
policies.content: Free standard ground shipping applies automatically to all orders over $50 before taxes.

policies.topic: Express Domestic Shipping
policies.content: Next-day express shipping is available for $19.99 on orders placed before 2:00 PM EST.

policies.topic: International Destination Support
policies.content: We ship directly to Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, Germany, and Japan.

policies.topic: International Delivery Timelines
policies.content: Standard international delivery takes 7-14 business days. Priority express takes 3-5 business days.

policies.topic: Customs Duties and Import Taxes
policies.content: International customers are responsible for any local customs duties or VAT applied by destination customs.

policies.topic: PO Box and APO/FPO Delivery
policies.content: Deliveries to PO Boxes and military APO/FPO addresses are sent via USPS Priority Mail only.

policies.topic: Standard Return Policy Window
policies.content: Items in new condition with original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

policies.topic: Refund Processing Timeline
policies.content: Approved refunds are credited back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

policies.topic: Return Shipping Cost Policy
policies.content: Return shipping is free for defective items. Non-defective returns incur a $4.99 return label fee.

policies.topic: Restocking Fees for Electronics
policies.content: Opened high-value electronics without defects carry a 15% restocking fee upon return.

policies.topic: Holiday Extended Return Period
policies.content: Purchases made between November 15 and December 25 can be returned through January 31.

policies.topic: Non-Returnable Product Categories
policies.content: In-ear headphones (opened), software downloads, gift cards, and custom-configured PCs cannot be returned.

policies.topic: Instant Store Credit Bonus
policies.content: Customers choosing store credit instead of a refund receive an extra 5% bonus credit.

policies.topic: Standard Manufacturer Warranty
policies.content: All brand-new electronic products include a 1-year limited hardware warranty against defects.

policies.topic: Refurbished Equipment Coverage
policies.content: Certified refurbished items carry a 90-day comprehensive hardware warranty.

policies.topic: Extended Warranty Protection Plans
policies.content: 2-year and 3-year TechCare extended protection plans are available during checkout.

policies.topic: Accidental Damage Protection
policies.content: TechCare Plus includes coverage for drops, spills, and cracked screens with a $25 deductible.

policies.topic: Warranty Claim Processing Steps
policies.content: To start a warranty claim, submit photos and a description at techstore-example.com/warranty.

policies.topic: Out-of-Warranty Repair Services
policies.content: Out-of-warranty diagnostic testing costs a flat $29 fee, which is applied toward repair costs if authorized.
